Players Committee card image of [[Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 2)]] (the2018 full-face design), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. This character (and other Palace Raiders) are deploy -3 if You're A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/palaceraider.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
